timeline.summary: Jace is sent to Thunder Junction to investigate an ancient vault and senses a child inside.
timeline.quote: Jace was sent to the abandoned plane of Thunder Junction to investigate the contents of an ancient vault

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska seize Loot during the Vault Heist.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Vraska seize Loot , the Fomori child that was locked in the vault, and disappear.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: On Thunder Junction Nashi breaks into the Slickshot Gang's headquarters, is stopped by Obeka, then succeeds by channeling story magic through video footage and steals the elixir.
timeline.quote: He was much more proficient with this method and successfully stole the elixir.

citation.text: "Nashi", section "Storyteller". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, with Vraska and disguised as Ashiok, uses Oko to assemble a team to break into Maag Taranau, wakes the child in stasis and leaves with it.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska left the other members of the team and disappeared with the child

citation.text: "Coin Empire", section "Heist of Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan settles on Thunder Junction after Oko leaves, and Amalia joins him to map the new plane.
timeline.quote: the two set off to map the newly-settled plane

citation.text: "Amalia Benavides Aguirre", section "On Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Archie sets off across the desert in a carriage with two Sterling guards, expecting bandits.
timeline.quote: His employer would never have provided two Sterling Company guards unless the job carried risks.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A wall of fire stops the carriage and the Hellspurs kill the Sterling guards.
timeline.quote: Nearly a dozen holes appeared across the side of the carriage, and the Sterling guards fell immediately.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul splits the carriage, takes the sack and declares the last key his, but finds only coal and flies into a rage.
timeline.quote: "Finally. The last key is mine."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Archie dies in the burning sand while the real key gets farther away from Akul.
timeline.quote: For all he cared about punctuality, he never expected to be so early to his own death.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie Flash follows the smoke on Fortune, recognises Akul's work in the burned carriage and finds an untouched lockbox of cash.
timeline.quote: A lockbox sat inside, untouched.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie deduces that the Hellspurs left the money because they were after something bigger.
timeline.quote: But they left the money behind—which meant they were after something else.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Yuma arrives in Omenport a year ago with the money sewn into his suit, walks into the desert and nearly dies of heat exhaustion.
timeline.quote: Heat exhaustion comes up on you unawares is what I've learned since then.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Yuma meets the baby cactusfolk Kirri, who leads him to a dry riverbed and saves his life.
timeline.quote: Low ground turned out to be a dry riverbed, cool water under the sand. So, I lived.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi recalls the day the Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo, after she was compleated.
timeline.quote: his mind was transported back to the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi practices story magic in the cactus forest with the memory of his mother, but falters when grief breaks his focus.
timeline.quote: Nashi faltered, and the sprout gave a weakened shudder before coiling back into the sand.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi relives a memory in which young Nashi, with a homemade bird gadget, is told by Tamiyo not to hide who he is.
timeline.quote: You are Nashi . That is who I'm proud of.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi realizes he is not so different from his mother, and finds his magic flows naturally when he loads recordings onto drones.
timeline.quote: Magic bristled at his fingertips, more naturally than ever before.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises a griffin-manticore from the ground and Geralf borrows a jackalope, and the siblings ride for Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: the two of them were off, riding across the wide-open plains of Thunder Junction toward their distant, unpleasant destination.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The siblings camp at night and Geralf observes that Gisa's zombies are not weakening, testing his planar theory.
timeline.quote: Her wellspring of Innistrad energy had yet to run dry.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf wakes Gisa, who fell asleep on watch, and they set off for Thief's Folly with her zombie animals following.
timeline.quote: They rode off into the dawn, Gisa's mismatched zombie army hopping, scurrying, and slithering after them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nine years earlier, young Jace is sent by Tezzeret to the Fomori vault and senses a childlike mind within.
timeline.quote: he feels a mind deep within the vault, sleepy with torpor, childlike and quiet.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reunite with the prize, a toddler-like child from the Fomori vault.
timeline.quote: The boy (Tamiyo's text said it was a boy) seems all too happy to take in the world around them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the child's mind and learns his name is Loot.
timeline.quote: "His name is Loot."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace sees that Loot's mind holds a map of the entire Multiverse and every Omenpath endpoint.
timeline.quote: It's the way to get from every point to every point.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska promise to protect Loot as their ward.
timeline.quote: Vraska and I will protect you with all of our strength.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: The three plan to walk through an Omenpath into the Multiverse, resolved that theirs will be better.
timeline.quote: Ours will be better.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: The great vault falls and scatters its wonders across Thunder Junction.
timeline.quote: When the great vault fell, it scattered its wonders across Thunder Junction.

citation.text: Sol Ring (Outlaws of Thunder Junction Commander, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akul's gang kills courier Archie Dixon and two guards seeking the final key piece, which is not there.
timeline.quote: killing a courier named Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Freestriders rob Akul and the Hellspurs, Akul hunts them and nearly kills Annie's nephew Tommy with his venom.
timeline.quote: Akul attacked them regardless, almost killing Annie's nephew Tommy with his venom

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feeling responsible, Annie takes Tommy into her care and quits the gang.
timeline.quote: she took Tommy into her care and quit the gang

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Annie accepts Oko's offer and learns the heist is aimed at Maag Taranau.
timeline.quote: Eventually, she decided to accede to Oko's request

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Annie and Eriette break Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa out of the Sterling Company's cells.
timeline.quote: As they broke the ancient warlock and the ninja free from their cells

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko kidnaps the scholar Nolan from a guarded train while Annie and Kellan save civilians before it crashes.
timeline.quote: Oko decided to kidnap him from the train he was riding into town on

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok extracts knowledge of the vault and keys from Nolan's brain.
timeline.quote: Ashiok extracted knowledge of the vault and the keys from Nolan

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko reveals he had secretly told Bertram Graywater where Tarnation was, expecting the Sterling Company to arrive.
timeline.quote: secretly shared the location of Tarnation with Bertram Graywater

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace uses Ashiok's image as a cover identity to recruit a raiding team for Maag Taranau, first freeing Eriette.
timeline.quote: The first use of this cover identity was to free Eriette from prison and recruit her.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Impersonation on Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Breeches joins the outlaw band as explosives expert and to secretly support Vraska.
timeline.quote: Breeches joined the team as an explosives expert

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gang plans to kidnap Nolan by blowing a bridge; Gisa deviates and the train nearly goes over before Kellan slows it.
timeline.quote: Kellan was able to slow the train enough for its passengers to escape before it was destroyed.

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko opens the vault for Jace and Vraska; Jace takes Loot and triggers a collapse, but the team escapes, after which Breeches and Malcolm leave the plane.
timeline.quote: Breeches and Malcolm left the plane.

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A herd of dinosaurs follows a Scalestorm Summoner through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction.
timeline.quote: A herd of dinosaurs followed a Scalestorm Summoner through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction

citation.text: "Dinosaur", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf writes a paper on how magic weakens on foreign planes, then he and Gisa travel to Thunder Junction and join Oko's crew with Geralf as medic.
timeline.quote: Geralf and his sister traveled through Omenpaths to Thunder Junction and joined Oko 's crew, in which Geralf served as the team's medic.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises the zombies too early during the train mission after the twins bicker, but Nolan is extracted.
timeline.quote: Provoked by Geralf and distracted, Gisa raised the zombies too early while the train was moving.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf travel through Omenpaths to Thunder Junction and become part of Oko's crew.
timeline.quote: Gisa and her brother traveled through Omenpaths to Thunder Junction , becoming part of Oko 's crew.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa summons ghouls too early, and the plan to extract Nolan from the train spirals out of control, though Nolan is extracted and the gang survives.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, Nolan was successfully extracted and the entire gang survived.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gonti works from a satellite office on Thunder Junction on two tracks.
timeline.quote: Gonti worked along two tracks.

citation.text: "Gonti", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska escape with Loot as the vault collapses.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska disappeared with Loot.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Thunder Junction, Oko recruits Kaervek for a heist on Maag Taranau; he is imprisoned by the Sterling Company and broken out by Eriette and Annie Flash.
timeline.quote: Eriette and Annie Flash broke them out

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek analyzes the vault key and warns that opening the vault may unleash a malevolent force akin to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: cautioned that opening the vault may unleash a malevolent force akin to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Insulted that Oko cannot pay, Kaervek warns him of dire consequences if Jace and Vraska are not found.
timeline.quote: Kaervek was insulted and warned Oko

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan takes a job with Niv-Mizzet and Ral's relay project bound for Thunder Junction, where Oko is said to be.
timeline.quote: He applied for the job and was accepted

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan recognizes his father Oko on the road to Prosperity, disrupting Oko's shapeshifting and forcing him to flee the Sterling Company.
timeline.quote: crossed paths with someone whom Kellan immediately recognized as his father

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko lets Kellan join his gang, where he is shocked to see Eriette and Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Oko decided to let Kellan join his gang

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko's gang kidnaps the scholar Nolan from a train, and Oko abandons the train and its innocent passengers.
timeline.quote: Oko went back on his promise and ran away.

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan grows magic vines to stall the train and save the passengers, and Annie helps him escape.
timeline.quote: Kellan managed to grow magic vines that stalled the train over the canyon, allowing the passengers to disembark

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral frees Kellan from a Sterling prison wagon and Kellan agrees to help him take the vault's treasure.
timeline.quote: Kellan agreed to the plan.

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan declines Ral's job offer and Amalia arrives to map the plane with him.
timeline.quote: Ral showed up to check on Kellan and offered him a job on Ravnica, but Kellan declined.

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav appears on Thunder Junction, likely to lay low and run the Dimir from the shadows.
timeline.quote: Lazav later appeared on Thunder Junction

citation.text: "Lazav", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malcolm joins Oko's outlaw team as a spotter to secretly support Vraska.
timeline.quote: Malcolm joined the team as a spotter

citation.text: "Malcolm Lee", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The team secures the key; Jace claims Loot and triggers a collapse; the team escapes.
timeline.quote: Jace revealed himself and secured his prize, a young creature named Loot .

citation.text: "Malcolm Lee", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok hires Oko for a heist of Maag Taranau, and they gather an outlaw crew.
timeline.quote: he was contacted by Ashiok and hired to perform a heist to steal the contents of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko recruits Annie Flash for her ability to see through illusions.
timeline.quote: attempting to recruit her for her ability to see through illusions

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko and the crew steal a vault key from Bertram Graywater's office.
timeline.quote: they secured the key

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko meets his son Kellan, who tracked him across planes, and takes him along as an asset.
timeline.quote: revealed himself to be his son Kellan , who had traveled across multiple planes looking for him

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gang hijacks Nolan's train; zombies overrun it and Oko abandons Kellan to save the passengers alone.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, he left his son to save the civilians alone.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew disbands; Oko learns Kellan awakened his fae powers and escaped, and chooses to stay absent from his life.
timeline.quote: Oko accepted this outcome, as it meant he could continue to be absent from Kellan's life.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
